inputs.text: The split happens as certain MPs bring up the possibility of a fresh discussion regarding the party's leadership. Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, which exposes a clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. Furthermore, the opposition leader did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump while declining to state whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran.
